findings.evidence: DerivationMap.lean:42-44 `[Semiring B]` for `derivationComp`; new `DerivationLinearMap` section declares `[CommSemiring B] [Algebra R B]`.

findings.evidence: HopfIdeal/Tangent.lean:24-33 Main declarations; public theorem at :157; used at Quotient/Kernel/Tangent.lean:106.
findings.fix: Add a bullet for `TauCeti.HopfIdeal.derivation_apply_eq_zero_of_mem_span` (a counit-valued derivation vanishing on counit-zero generators vanishes on the generated ideal) and one clause in the overview saying the file supplies it.
findings.issue: The Main declarations list was updated for `quotientLinearMap` and `mem_lieSubalgebra_iff_of_toIdeal_eq_span` but omits the new public `derivation_apply_eq_zero_of_mem_span` (line 157), which is general-purpose and is consumed from another module; the module overview (lines 14-22) also describes the file as being only about the closed-subgroup differential and its image, so a reader has no indication this criterion lives here.

summary: New declarations are documented accurately, but moving `derivationVanishingIdeal` out of Kernel/Tangent.lean left a docstring naming a declaration no longer in that file, and two module docstrings are now inaccurate/incomplete.
